2607.24419.title: Failures Reveal What Metrics Miss: An Evidence-Driven Agent for Recursive Refinement of ECG Classifiers
2607.24419.paper_summary: Deep models have substantially advanced 12-lead ECG classification, yet their refinement still relies heavily on human experts to inspect failures and iteratively revise classifier designs. Recent LLM-based agents have demonstrated the potential for automated model design, but when guided only by aggregate performance metrics, they lack insight into why individual cases fail and how the classifier should be revised. We present RecursiveECG, an evidence-driven LLM-as-Designer framework in which an LLM serves as an offline model designer that refines ECG classifiers based on concrete failures and objective ECG evidence. To ground failure diagnosis in executable evidence, Criteria-to-Measurement Compilation converts curated ECG criteria into validated deterministic functions that produce reproducible, reference-backed measurements for individual ECGs. Building on these measurements, Evidence-Grounded Failure Review analyzes failed and comparator cases by jointly considering raw waveforms, measurements, and model outputs, enabling the LLM to diagnose classifier limitations and formulate targeted revisions. Candidate revisions are executed and re-evaluated under a fixed problem contract, and only evidence-supported updates are retained. The resulting predictor is frozen after refinement and requires no LLM inference during deployment, while an audit trail links each accepted revision to its supporting evidence. Across PTB-XL, Georgia, and CPSC2018, RecursiveECG consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average relative improvement of 10.0%. Extensive ablation and transfer studies further validate the effectiveness of its evidence-grounded refinement process.
2607.24419.paper_summary_zh: 深度模型在12導程心電圖分類方面已經取得了顯著進展，但其精細化仍然在很大程度上依賴於人類專家檢查失敗案例並迭代修訂分類器設計。最近基於大型語言模型（LLM）的代理顯示出自動化模型設計的潛力，但當僅依賴綜合性能指標進行指導時，它們缺乏對個別案例失敗原因的洞察，以及如何修訂分類器的理解。我們提出了RecursiveECG，一個以證據為驅動的LLM作為設計者框架，其中LLM作為離線模型設計者，根據具體失敗和客觀的心電圖證據來精細化心電圖分類器。為了將失敗診斷基於可執行的證據，標準到測量編譯將策劃的心電圖標準轉換為經過驗證的確定性函數，這些函數為個別心電圖產生可重複的、以參考為支持的測量。基於這些測量，證據驅動的失敗回顧通過共同考慮原始波形、測量和模型輸出來分析失敗和對比案例，使LLM能夠診斷分類器的局限性並制定針對性的修訂。候選修訂在固定問題合約下執行並重新評估，只有得到證據支持的更新才會被保留。經過精細化後，最終的預測器被凍結，並且在部署期間不需要LLM推理，而審計追蹤將每個接受的修訂與其支持證據聯繫起來。在PTB-XL、喬治亞州和CPSC2018中，RecursiveECG始終超越強基線，實現了平均相對提升10.0%。廣泛的消融和轉移研究進一步驗證了其以證據為基礎的精細化過程的有效性。
